name: settings-memory-saver
description: The page applies the settings of the start document of a project twice, and it sends the theme and the menu language of each application to the host in the order of the applications; a project that holds a common-only key and a write of an out-of-range value are refused without a call.
reason: The calls setTheme and setMenuLanguage apply to the window of the native host, which the Go producer does not run (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).
